messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: model-quality-degradation for model rwd-llama-large v2026-03-10 in eu-west1, P2. Affected requests >10% error rate and significant drop in eval metric. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall.
ryan (oncall): ack. jumping in. initial check — tails of latency look normal but quality scores from eval-agent dropped ~22% starting at 2059873000. any deploys around then?
sophie (eng-runtime): we had an automated rollout of rwd-llama-large v2026-03-10 at 2059872900. I see a small spike in CPU mem-copy errors on the inference nodes in eu-west1 at 2059872955.
ajay (eng-ml): confirmed quality regression on our golden prompt set, most failures are hallucinations on numerical tables. rolling back locally to v2026-02-25 reproduces good behavior.
melissa (support): we already have 3 customer tickets referencing incorrect outputs in finance templates. they're marked high priority. customers: AcmeCorp, FinLedger, HelixForms.
tao (product): need impact assessment + recommended public status message. priority: minimize customer churn. if rollback is safe, let's prefer that.
ryan (oncall): plan proposal: 1) pin production traffic in eu-west1 to v2026-02-25 (older stable) 2) update status page with incident and ETA 3) notify impacted customers with draft. objections?
sophie (eng-runtime): agree. pinning command ready: ```rdwctl model pin --model rwd-llama-large --version v2026-02-25 --region eu-west1``` will route new traffic to pinned variant. also can set gradual drain: ```rdwctl rollout set-weight --model rwd-llama-large --from v2026-03-10 --to v2026-02-25 --weight 80``` to move 80% immediately.
ajay (eng-ml): double-checking: v2026-02-25 passes current evals and matches latency. regressions are likely from generation headroom changes in the new checkpoint.
ops-lead: ensure we don't disrupt dedicated customers on reserved pools. Sophie, can you confirm pin doesn't affect Dedicated customers pinned explicitly?
sophie (eng-runtime): confirmed — Dedicated capacity honors customer pinning and won't be changed. our pin command affects shared-hosted routing only unless a customer is using Hosted and hasn't pinned.
ryan (oncall): ok executing pin now. will post revert log.
ryan (oncall): (executed) rdwctl model pin --model rwd-llama-large --version v2026-02-25 --region eu-west1 — response: 200 OK, routing updated. Monitoring effects for next 5m.
incident-bot: Note: automated regression-detector flagged reduced failure rate after routing change (5m window). Metric: golden-prompt-failures dropped from 14% -> 3% in eu-west1.
melissa (support): drafting customer DM. Draft preview: "We observed an issue impacting output quality for rwd-llama-large in eu-west1. We've routed traffic to a prior stable version and expect normal behavior. If you continue to see issues, please reply and we'll open a ticket. — Redwood Inference Team" Thoughts?
tao (product): good concise copy, add: "ETA for completion: 30 minutes; we'll follow up with a post-incident summary." also add contact link to account team.
ajay (eng-ml): follow-up action: binary bisect on v2026-03-10 changes to identify offending commit. I'll take ownership and loop in research.
sophie (eng-runtime): ops checklist: 1) confirm latency SLOs 2) ensure cache invalidation for KV-cache between variants 3) keep additional canary in us-west2 to detect cross-region issue. doing step 1 now.
ryan (oncall): update status page draft: "Investigating — We detected a quality regression for rwd-llama-large impacting a subset of hosted requests in eu-west1. We have routed traffic to a known-good model variant, and are monitoring. Impact: incorrect or lower-quality text generation for ~10-15% of hosted requests in eu-west1. Mitigation: traffic routing applied. Next update: 30 minutes." anyone want to tweak wording?
melissa (support): looks good. I'll send DM to AcmeCorp/FinLedger/HelixForms with tailored notes and open internal tickets.
ops-lead: when Ajay has root cause, include recommended action: hotfix vs revert vs model patch. If hotfix wanted, we'll schedule a canary with strict evaluation gating.
ajay (eng-ml): pointer: initial suspect is a tokenizer merge that changed float rounding in table decoding. bisect will confirm. ETA: 3 hours for root-cause + remediation plan.
ryan (oncall): excellent. handing off active monitoring to Sophie for the 30m window then Ajay will take next lead for root cause. I'll update incident documentation and close the pager once we have stable metrics for 15m.
sophie (eng-runtime): monitoring steady. golden-prompt-failures at 2.8% now. keeping alert thresholds raised.
melissa (support): customer DMs sent. one reply asking for more details; routing to AE and Ajay for technical follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> Mitigated; assignees -> ajay (eng-ml); links -> https://redwood/status/incidents/2059876543. This thread will be used for postmortem notes and customer message templates."
